$comment: Pinned upstream sources fetched by scripts/bootstrap.ps1. The checkouts themselves are gitignored; only these pins are committed. Never follow a branch tip -- bump the commit deliberately and note why.

pins.name: sc2-galaxy-toolkit
pins.why: Galaxy/GameData/trigger/text/layout parsing. Upstream is work-in-progress with active refactor/* branches, so the tip is never safe to follow. Consumed only through packages/sc2-toolkit-adapter.

pins.name: StormLib
pins.why: MPQ read/write for the sc2mpq sidecar. Pinned to the v9.40 release tag rather than master: a repack that corrupts a map is the worst failure this project can have, so the archive library must not move under us.
